summary: The final combined H06I plus H06H source candidate passes the quiet-window OS-isolated 214-test R2 suite with no concurrent production-state warning.
facts: 214 tests passed in 61.956 seconds with no failure, error, skip or concurrent production-KB warning.
The combined source is H06I commit 2c7316d, H06H candidate cb2955a, isolated-harness repair 809e9cd and release cachebuster 920fd4c.

A separate release-level nine-module matrix passed 524 tests in 220.449 seconds with one explicit native Windows PowerShell conditional skip; its unrelated concurrent production-KB observation is not used as the quiet-window proof.
